reviews.title: Do not deliver on time
reviews.text: Great selection of wines, but if I pay extra for delivery by a certain date I expect that delivery to happen. I certainly don’t expect to be told it won’t be delivered on the day.

reviews.title: Good thing comes to an end
reviews.text: Having been with you years it’s so sad to have to leave because you have simply made your prices so high it is no longer viable to justify the cost.

reviews.title: Network issue
reviews.text: Hi, I’m trying to get into the app and it says it has network issue. A TLS error has caused the secure connection to fail.

reviews.title: New C.E.O
reviews.text: Since the CEO has joined I feel we are not getting value for money and the choices seem less I would like to see the old CEO come back then I will buy from Naked wines again I will be stopping my future buys

reviews.title: Unable to change delivery address
reviews.text: A case of wine ordered but at checkout, I was unable to change the delivery address on several attempts, and unable to change to a free delivery service.

reviews.title: Shady App
reviews.text:
Contribution money each month an when I eventually come to order 9 bottles of wine the app asks “add two more bottles to complete your order”. Why?? 

Process payment and instead of taking you through a payment screen like any website for authorisation they immediately take payment, didn’t let me select Apple Pay or an alternative card.. 

Switched bank accounts and didn’t update cards on the app. I was hounded for weeks to update records. 

Everything about this app and Naked Wines feels like tricks and manipulation to maximise the amount of money they can squeeze out of you.
